question: The inaugural edition of the National Beach Soccer Championship was held at _________ in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The inaugural edition of the National Beach Soccer Championship was held in **Surat** in 2023.
 
• Surat is a city located in the western Indian state of Gujarat.
 
• The city is known for its diamond cutting and polishing industry, as well as its vibrant textile sector.
 
• Hosting the National Beach Soccer Championship highlights Surat's growing importance as a center for sports and cultural events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Beach Soccer Championship is aimed at promoting beach soccer as a sport in India.
 
• It provides a platform for players from different regions to showcase their talent and gain recognition.
 
• Surat's coastline and infrastructure make it an ideal location for hosting such events.
 
• The success of the inaugural edition is expected to boost tourism and local economy in Surat.
